title: ReceiptGuard — the agent that can't lie about its tools
subject: A support autopilot that acts only on tool results it can prove, and escalates the rest to humans
tagline: Acts only on what it can prove.
_duration_note: Aim ~2:30 (150s); hard cap 180s. Slack-session lesson: a 1:36 cut felt thin — fill with a split-screen contrast + a multi-feature montage, don't pad with dead air.
named_task: Resolve this refund ticket — and prove every tool result

voice._note: LOCKED: id=Sarah (calm-confident WOMAN, Anthropic-presentation register). Slack-session lesson U29 — never a generic/male voice; that was rejected. 0.96 speed = breathing room.
voice._draft_rule: edge-tts fallback (female en-US-AvaNeural) is DRAFT ONLY for fast iteration. The final master MUST use ElevenLabs — build.mjs warns if a draft VO reaches package/validate.
voice._key_rule: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY lives in <project>/.env (see .env.example) and is NEVER pasted into chat. If a key is ever exposed in a transcript, rotate it.

music._note: Keyless CC0/royalty-free only. duck_db = how far music drops under VO.

capture._live_rule: LIVE APP ONLY. capture-kit refuses file://, about:, blank pages unless allow_mock:true. Slack-session lesson U34: the agent kept shipping 'styled recreations' instead of real footage — that loses. Start the real app, point base_url at it. Reuse a signed-in session via storage_state (a Playwright storageState JSON) instead of mockups.

_humanize_note: Video humanizer: subtle handheld drift + gate flicker on motion-graphic scenes so they read as shot, not generated. Capture footage stays locked. false = perfectly locked.
